关键词: Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act
主要内容: The Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act (CAATSA), signed into law on August 2, 2017, imposes new sanctions on Iran, Russia, and North Korea. The law includes three titles, each addressing different aspects of sanctions. Title I focuses on countering Iran’s destabilizing activities, Title II on countering Russian influence in Europe and Eurasia, and Title III on North Korea. The Treasury Department and the Department of State have been delegated authority to implement these provisions. OFAC provides guidance and updates on CAATSA-related sanctions, including frequently asked questions and regulatory changes. The implementation of CAATSA is supported by executive orders and public laws, with modifications to regulations posted in the Federal Register.
